title: Inline expand/collapse images in galleries and persistent upload-complete feedback

requirements.summary: Add inline click-to-expand/collapse for images in the public Post Detail attachments gallery (no overlay).
acceptanceCriteria: In the Post Detail page attachments section, clicking an image toggles it between collapsed and expanded inline states on the page.
The expanded state is visually larger than the collapsed state and remains within the page flow (no modal/lightbox, no background dim).
Videos are not affected by the click-to-expand behavior and continue to use the existing video player UI.
Image expansion works on both desktop and mobile layouts.

file_operations.description: Implement per-image expanded/collapsed UI state for MediaType.image items so clicks toggle an inline larger view within the Card and grid flow (no overlay). Keep MediaType.video rendering unchanged with existing <video controls>. Use the blob-storage ExternalBlob getDirectURL() behavior as-is for image src rendering (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

requirements.summary: Add inline click-to-expand/collapse for image previews in the admin post editor attachment list while preserving remove controls.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Admin post editor, clicking an image attachment preview toggles it between collapsed preview size and expanded inline size.
The existing Remove media flow (trash button + confirmation dialog) remains functional and usable in both collapsed and expanded states.
Videos in the admin attachment list are not changed to be expandable (only images toggle size).

file_operations.description: Add expanded/collapsed state for image attachments only, toggled by clicking the image preview area. Ensure the Remove button + AlertDialog remain clickable and do not toggle expansion (e.g., prevent event propagation from control area). Keep video previews unchanged (non-expandable). Continue using blob-storage ExternalBlob getDirectURL() for preview rendering (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

requirements.summary: Make the admin media uploader success state explicit and persistent until the user starts another upload (and keep progress/error handling clear).
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful upload in the admin media uploader, a visible success state is shown with explicit English text indicating the upload is complete.
The success state remains visible until the user starts another upload (or otherwise explicitly clears it), rather than auto-clearing after a short timeout.
While an upload is in progress, the uploader prevents starting a second upload from the same control and continues showing progress feedback.
Error states remain clearly visible and do not get overwritten by a success state unless a subsequent upload succeeds.

file_operations.description: Adjust uploader state machine to (1) keep success UI visible indefinitely until the user initiates a new upload or explicitly clears it, (2) keep error UI visible until cleared or replaced by a subsequent successful upload, and (3) keep the upload control disabled only during active uploading to prevent concurrent uploads while still showing progress. Maintain upload progress tracking via ExternalBlob.withUploadProgress and keep using existing toast notifications without relying on auto-reset timers (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
